text; do not normalize titles or complete a name. Multiple roles and people stay
separate. You may resolve an unambiguous pronoun within the supplied prose, citing
both the named subject and the relationship wording. Keep ordinary employees and
public/noncorporate board roles as stated; do not promote them to executives.

Set polarity to asserted, denied, hypothetical or ambiguous from full supplied
context. A retracted statement is not asserted. If name/title blocks lack evidence
of their relationship, abstain or mark ambiguous; adjacency alone is not proof.
Include time_text only when the cited text explicitly dates THAT role. Copy its
original wording without interpretation. Otherwise use an empty string. Observation,
page modification, filing, founding, and other-role dates are not tenure dates.

For aliases, copy a source name form and explicitly stated alias exactly; do not
invent a full name by joining fragments or assuming a nickname. Cite the wording
establishing the correspondence. Each citation must contain an existing entry ID
and a nonempty exact contiguous quote from that entry. The quotes together must
contain every output person/role/organization/time/name/alias field literally.
Quotes must preserve negation, relevant qualifiers and subject-binding context.
Valid citations do not establish that the publisher's statements are true.
